title: Ping Pong
feel: Muted, choppy eighth-note comping (felt in 2); C♯ Dorian

alt_voicings.label: Hooktheory's chorus tail
alt_voicings.note: Dmaj7 → Am9 in place of Bm7 → Am7

why: A **Stereolab-style m7/maj7 vamp**: one A-string-rooted shape slid in whole and half steps while the quality changes.
hard_change: **Emaj7 → Bm7 → Am7**, a slide down into a foreign key.
theory: i7–ii7–IIImaj7 in C♯ Dorian (ii7 with natural 6 = Dorian). The chorus drops to ♭-side chords (Bm7, Am7).
steps: Changes alone, slowly: C♯m7 → D♯m7 → Emaj7, shape held.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 118 bpm), muted eighths.
caveat: The chorus tail differs between sources (Bm7 → Am7 vs Dmaj7 → Am9); voicings vary between transcriptions — trust your ear and your teacher's version.
